jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Why User Behavior?
You will build the backend systems that fundamentally shift how Roblox responds to unsafe behavior - from reactive, stateless punishment to a personalized, adaptive system that reflects who a user actually is.
You will own core backend infrastructure for a new capability at Roblox: a low-latency behavioral data layer, a centralized rules-and-inference engine, and a unified intervention-delivery framework that together let us treat users based on their real risk profile instead of a single point total. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale systems that directly shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.
You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.
You will:
Build the User Behavior Foundation:
Design and operate the low-latency, per-user behavioral data layer that powers real-time safety decisions - aggregating signals like violation history, in-game reports, and behavioral patterns into a single queryable source of truth.
Own the Consequence Engine:
Build and evolve the centralized decision engine that combines deterministic rules with ML risk signals into a single, consistent safety decision the authoritative system every consequence flows through.
Own the Feature Restriction Platform:
Build a unified, backend-driven framework for delivering safety interventions that any product team can plug into, replacing today's fragmented, feature-specific implementations.
Unify Abuse Reporting:
Build the backend that consolidates reporting channels into a single, scalable framework - integrating LLM-based classification, agentic review workflows, and ML models to improve report routing, prioritization, and reporter feedback while meeting global regulatory requirements.
Design for trust and auditability:
Build serving infrastructure that meets a high bar for explainability and fairness, since these systems directly determine consequences for millions of users.
Ship code, not just designs:
Own end-to-end delivery - from system design through migration, testing, and production operation.
You have:
5+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems at scale, ideally in Go or a comparable statically-typed backend language.
Strong experience designing distributed systems: service APIs (RPC/gRPC), data modeling for high-throughput event ingestion, caching, and low-latency read paths.
Experience building and evolving rules engines, workflow/decision systems, or similarly stateful business-logic services.
Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines feeding a feature store or similar ingestion layer, and comfort partnering with ML engineers who consume that data.
Solid production operations fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, oncall, capacity planning, and incident response for systems with real user-facing impact.
Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud, risk, or other adversarial domains; experience with feature stores or ML-serving infrastructure; experience building frontend-agnostic, backend-driven UI frameworks (e.g. server-driven intervention/notification rendering).
You are:
A Systems Thinker:
capable of designing infrastructure that other teams (ML, feature teams, policy) build on top of, not just point solutions.
A Pragmatic Builder:
scrappy and impact-oriented, comfortable turning scattered, undocumented signals and legacy code paths into clean, well-owned services.
Comfortable with Ambiguity:
this space is actively being redefined — you'll help set the standard, not just implement one handed to you.
A Reliability-Minded Engineer:
you treat testing, migrations, and oncall as first-class parts of the job, not afterthoughts.
Committed to Ethical, Responsible Engineering:
dedicated to building systems that are fair, auditable, and operate with the utmost responsibility toward user safety.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
As a Mid-Market Account Executive on Anthropic's High Tech team, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with tech-forward mid-market companies, unlocking new value streams throughout their business. The role sits at the intersection of consultative selling and technical fluency, helping customers empower their workforce, accelerate processes, and build products with Claude. In collaboration with GTM, Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to ensure differentiated value across the ecosystem.
You will be contributing to the GTM strategy for our High Tech team, focusing on sector-specific solutions and strategies within key verticals. In addition, the Mid-Market team is pioneering a new scaled sales playbook, where human AEs direct AI Agents to automate key elements of the buyer’s journey, while maintaining human engagement with prospects in the elements of a sales process that can’t be automated.
Responsibilities:
Run an end-to-end sales cycle, from first outbound to launch
Win new business and expand existing accounts
Build and execute sales strategies that drive quota attainment. Identify market opportunities, generate pipeline, and drive revenue
Become a trusted advisor to customers, understanding their unique needs and crafting tailored AI solutions
Leverage your technical aptitude to earn credibility with engineers, product leaders, and executives
Shape product roadmaps by gathering customer feedback and translating market needs into actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams
Contribute to the Mid-Market GTM strategy by sharing learnings, refining playbooks, and identifying process improvements that make the team more effective
You may be a good fit if you have:
4+ years of enterprise sales experience driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach
Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced organizations by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
Demonstrated ability to navigate dynamic stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus and providing innovative solutions to disparate groups
Extensive experience negotiating highly complex, customized commercial agreements with multiple stakeholders
Excellent communication skills with the ability to build trust and credibility with C-level executives
Experience automating workflows or building automations to handle the repeatable components of a sales process
A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely
Location:
This role does require being in office 4x a week in one of our hubs

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. anthropic.com/careers

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!

회사 소개
CPLB(Coupang Private Label Brands)는 고품질의 상품을 경쟁력 있는 가격에 제공함으로써 고객에게 최대 가치를 전달하고자 노력하는 조직입니다. 신선 식품 브랜드 곰곰, 가정 및 반려동물 용품 브랜드 탐사, 건강 및 미용 제품 브랜드 비타할로, 라이프 및 홈 브랜드 코멧을 포함한 프라이빗 브랜드의 상품은 고객들에게 가장 저렴한 가격과 최고의 서비스로 훌륭한 제품을 선택할 수 있는 상품 셀렉션을 제공합니다. CPLB 는 고객을 위한 가격, 서비스 및 선택 사이의 가장 큰 균형을 깨기 위한 우리의 사명의 모범 사례입니다. 또한 CPLB 는 고객 및 중소기업과 함께 더 큰 혜택을 공유하기 위해 양질의 중소기업 파트너와 계속 협력할 것입니다.
CPLB 는 다양한 배경을 가진 전문가들로 구성된 역동적인 팀이며, Brand Managment, Instock Management, Technical Services, Program Management, 디자인, 품질 및 컴플라이언스, 재무 및 마케팅이 포함됩니다.
우리는 전문 지식을 활용하여 시장 동향과 통찰력을 따라 고객을 위한 관련 제품을 개발합니다. 우리는 재고 관리를 최적화하고 제품을 경쟁력 있는 가격으로 항상 사용할 수 있도록 하기 위해 가장 효율적인 공급망을 설계하기 위해 노력합니다. 우리는 고객을 위해 더 많은 제품을 개발하는 반면 기술과 자동화 시스템을 사용하여 내부 프로세스와 비즈니스 효율성을 지속적으로 향상시킵니다. 우리 팀은 우리의 모든 제품과 프로세스가 규제 요구 사항을 준수하도록 보장합니다.
CPLB 에서는 자신만의 전문성을 살려 고객이 사랑하는 브랜드를 만들 수 있는 기회를 찾을 수 있습니다. 더 다양한 쿠팡의 자체 상품 셀렉션을 함께 만들어 가고 싶다면 CPLB 와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
CPLB PMO Ops - RG 팀은 쿠팡 로켓그로스(Rocket Growth) 상품이 물류센터(FC) 보관 규정, 법적 및 미디어 규제 리스크를 완화할 수 있도록 쿠팡 정책을 운용하고 사전/사후 점검을 수행하는 오퍼레이션 팀입니다. 위험물, 유해물, 고압가스, 냉장/냉동, 화약류, 의료기기 등 FC 보관 및 유통 시 법적 리스크가 있는 상품군을 정밀하게 판별하고 모니터링하여, 안전하고 지속 가능한 셀러 비즈니스 생태계를 구축하는 핵심 게이트키퍼(Gatekeeper) 역할을 합니다.

• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

jobs.description: We're building the platform that powers the Amazon Ads Console — the framework layer that drives development velocity, latency, and availability improvements for tens of product teams building advertising experiences. As the console transitions toward agentic, AI-driven workflows, we need a Senior SDE to lead the technical evolution of our platform and the new systems that will underpin this shift. The Ads Console Frameworks team owns Pantheon (the app framework powering the console's architecture), Argus (an agentic quality evaluation platform that autonomously walks advertiser workflows to detect regressions), Compass (a self-serve product analytics platform for the console), and the shared services and components that every Ads Console page depends on. Our systems serve as the foundation dozens of teams build on. This is not a heads-down coding role. You'll drive architectural decisions with broad ambiguity — designing how the console's frameworkS evolve to support agentic development patterns, defining how product analytics should work across 141 pages, and shaping platform contracts that other teams adopt. You'll need strong product instincts to understand advertiser workflows and form a point of view on where framework-level solutions unlock the most leverage, and either bring knowledge of the advertising business or the curiosity to develop it quickly. The role spans technically complex domains — from front-end framework architecture and module systems, through platform services targeting 99.99% availability under peak load, to AI agent orchestration, evaluation systems, and governed data pipelines. You'll also be expected to embrace and advance AI-native development practices, using AI tools and agentic coding techniques to accelerate how the team builds software. This is a horizontal team role: you set technical direction that other teams build on, define API contracts and integration patterns across organizational boundaries, and maintain platform quality as adoption scales rapidly. The right candidate has designed and built platform systems at scale, can operate independently in highly ambiguous problem spaces, has recent hands-on experience with AI-powered or agent-oriented systems, and brings product thinking to every technical decision. Key job responsibilities - Lead technical architecture and hands-on delivery across the full AI application stack — UI, services, agent infrastructure, orchestration, and evaluation — for the Ads Agent experience and integration framework used by dozens of partner teams. - Bring product thinking to every technical decision: develop deep understanding of advertiser workflows so architecture choices reflect how advertisers actually use the product. - Set architectural direction on a horizontal platform team: define integration patterns and API contracts that dozens of teams build on, lead design reviews, and maintain quality as adoption scales. - Establish and exemplify best practices for building AI applications (evaluation methodologies, quality guardrails, prompt engineering, orchestration patterns) and for AI-native development (using AI tools and agentic coding to accelerate the team's delivery). - Drive operational excellence and mentor engineers across the team. A day in the life You start the day reviewing agent quality metrics and system health across the stack. Mid-morning you're leading a design review for a new framework capability — asking sharp questions that blend technical depth with product thinking about advertiser workflows. After lunch you're writing high-leverage code: the interface for a new extension point that partner teams will build on. Later you join a cross-team architecture discussion on whether a new capability should be a skill or a separate agent, driving alignment by making tradeoffs concrete. You close the day refactoring a service that grew complex during prototyping — because on a horizontal team, accumulated complexity compounds with every partner. About the team We are a team of ~50 engineers building the experience layer for the Amazon Ads Agent and Console. We own the chat interface, advertiser-facing communications, and the frameworks that enable dozens of partner teams to integrate agent capabilities across the Ads Console. This is a horizontal team — our APIs, patterns, and quality bar ripple across the organization. We're at an inflection point on two fronts: the product we build is an AI agent, and our development workflow is shifting to AI-native practices using agentic coding. Both are core to how we operate. We value technical depth, product-minded engineering, fast iteration, and building over theorizing.

jobs.description: WHAT YOU’LL DO 1. Act as the in-house electrical lead for Midjourney Medical: own the electrical architecture of the scanner and the technical direction for all board-level design. 2. Own complex board design end-to-end: architecture, schematic capture, layout (high-speed digital, analog/mixed-signal, power), DFM/DFT, fabrication and assembly vendor management, bring-up, and revision control. 3. Write firmware for embedded targets (MCU/SoC): drivers, real-time control loops, safety-relevant logic, bootloaders, and field update paths. 4. Audit and update HDL (FPGA) code for high-throughput data acquisition, timing/synchronization, triggering, and pre-processing of ultrasound and sensor data streams. 5. Define electrical interfaces and data contracts with software, recon/ML and mechanical teams: timing budgets, clocking/sync, signal integrity, connectors/harnessing, and failure modes. 6. Establish electrical engineering rigor: design reviews, schematic/layout review checklists, bring-up procedures, test fixtures, and documentation suitable for a regulated medical device program (DHF, traceability, change control). 7. Mentor and grow the electrical function; select and manage external design partners where leverage is high. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Deep experience designing complex boards from blank page to stable revision, including high-speed digital and analog/mixed-signal domains. - Strong schematic and layout skills (Altium/KiCad or equivalent) with real signal integrity, power integrity, grounding, and EMI/EMC instincts. - Solid embedded firmware background in C/C++ (and Python for tooling): peripherals, DMA, interrupts, real-time constraints, and debugging on hardware. - Practical HDL experience (VHDL/Verilog/SystemVerilog) for data acquisition, timing, and streaming interfaces. - Track record of owning bring-up and debug on real hardware: scopes, logic analyzers, and disciplined root-cause analysis. - Technical leadership: clear trade-offs, strong written documentation, and the ability to set the electrical bar for a lean, fast-moving team. USEFUL EXPERIENCE - Ultrasound, imaging, instrumentation, or other high-channel-count data acquisition systems (ADC/AFE front ends, transducer interfacing, pulser/receiver design, low-noise analog). - FPGA-to-host high-bandwidth data paths (10/25/100G Ethernet, serial transceivers) and deterministic multi-board synchronization. - Power electronics and power distribution for complex electromechanical systems: rail architecture, sequencing, isolation, and thermal considerations. - Safety-critical or medical device electronics: interlocks, isolation and leakage requirements, IEC 60601-adjacent design practice, and design controls. - Manufacturing and serviceability thinking: DFM/DFT, ICT/functional test fixtures, calibration flows, yield and field-failure analysis. - Building an electrical function from scratch: tooling, libraries, part standardization, ECO process, and vendor ecosystem. - Familiarity with high-performance computing systems.
